snippets.snippet_text: "On December 10, 2025, I purchased one course from Domestika and paid a total of 49 TL for this transaction. The description of the transaction reflected on my credit card statement was \"Order C5110**19T33503436\". However, on January 10, 2026, I noticed an unauthorized deduction of 6,400 TL from my credit card by Domestika under the code \"Order C5158**62T33959279\"."
